scope: Bounded exact checks of route obstructions and a conditional counting lemma; no unrestricted asymptotic advance or novelty assertion.

volume_obstruction.scope: Exact determinant controls for an infinite symbolic construction; the uniform proof is in the research note.
volume_obstruction.conclusion: The full moment-polytope volume has order n^(2d) even in the generic point-ideal case. A smaller universal full-volume bound cannot improve the existing proof.

disjoint_socle_relation_control.uniform_conclusion: For this whole three-variable construction, g(I)=O(n^(4/3)); it cannot beat the existing generic n^2(log n)^2 order.
disjoint_socle_relation_control.proof_location: docs/interleaving_research.md, First feasibility pass: two rigorous route obstructions

overlapping_socle_relations.uniform_conclusion: Arbitrary relation spaces confined to the socle give O_d(n^(d(d-1)/(d+1))) initial staircases, by an antichain coordinate budget and the established lattice-polytope bound.
overlapping_socle_relations.scope_exclusion: Relations with surviving nonconstant multiples are not covered.

rectangular_spanning_control.conditional_conclusion: If every monomial box of volume at least kappa*n spans, every standard basis is determined by a geometric word of length d^d*kappa*n. The existing ordered-prefix theorem then gives O_d((kappa*n)^(d-1)(log(kappa*n+1))^(d-1)).
rectangular_spanning_control.scope_exclusion: The spanning parameter is not universally bounded; the diagonal family has growing parameter and only d initial ideals.

cartesian_rank_delay_control.uniform_conclusion: Translated Cartesian axis staircases give radical point ideals with g(I)=1, no zero monomial evaluations, and minimum geometric rank-completion length Omega_d(n^d). A linear rank-delay bound cannot be imposed on all point ideals.

binomial_parallel_class_control.uniform_conclusion: For every colength-n binomial ideal in fixed dimension d>=2, g(I)=O_d(n^(d-1)(log(n+1))^((d-1)^2)), by the known normal-form reduction, hyperbolic cross and Minkowski-sum vertex bound.
binomial_parallel_class_control.priority: Recorded as a consequence of existing tools, not an established novel theorem or an unrestricted advance.

nonpartition_point_control.conclusion: Five distinct nonzero residue lines have rank four. Selecting one representative from each line does not give a basis. The binomial proof does not apply to all point ideals.
nonpartition_point_control.scope: This refutes only the proposed automatic partition-matroid extension, not every possible Minkowski decomposition.

truncated_partition_point_control.rank_rule: Over positive real samples, columns of distinct t-degrees form a generalized Vandermonde matrix; rank equals min(n, number of distinct degrees). This is a truncation of the degree-class partition matroid.
truncated_partition_point_control.scope: A finite realizable test of a proposed lower-family mechanism, not an asymptotic advance or a novelty claim.

pure_power_sector_control.uniform_conclusion: Primitive pure-power relations supply d sector boxes. The lattice-polytope moment bound gives O_A(n^(d-1)) for every finite quotient on a fixed monomial curve, over every field; this rules out a fixed-curve asymptotic separation from the generic order.
pure_power_sector_control.scope: A restricted consequence of the established state-polytope vertex estimate; not an unrestricted improvement or an established novelty claim.

coarse_class_path_control.conclusion: The two different initial staircases are in one connected halfspace-deformation class with the same selected degree classes. A coarse colored k-set count cannot be used directly as the number of initial ideals.

normal_curve_lower_control.uniform_conclusion: The ideals of n distinct positive samples (t,t^2,...,t^d) have Theta_d(n^(d-1)) initial ideals. The full proof combines the fixed-curve upper bound with an explicit open family of ray allocations.
normal_curve_lower_control.scope: A sharp restricted-family control below the existing generic logarithmic order. It does not improve the unrestricted lower bound and novelty has not been established.
normal_curve_lower_control.point_description: For each fixture take t=1,...,n over Q; ray residue i has monomials x_i*x_d^k, with x_0=1.

relative_socle_control.uniform_conclusion: For the stated finite monomial reference (or the justified product reference), relations supported on the relative socle in s specified variables and closed under the remaining multiplications give O_d(n^((2*d-s)*(d-1)/(d+1))) initial ideals. In dimension three the layer argument improves s=1 to O(n^(7/3)); s=2 gives O(n^2), with a matching family of lengths 6L.
relative_socle_control.scope: A restricted mechanism with genuinely surviving z multiples; it cannot beat the existing unrestricted generic lower order. No novelty or unrestricted improvement is asserted.

hook_first_order_deformation_control.uniform_conclusion: Every flat first-order deformation of (y^r,y*z,z^s), r,s>=2, has O((r+s)^2) initial ideals as a length-2(r+s-1) algebra in three variables. Three connecting columns suffice after deleting a coloop and two blocks with O(r+s) internal comparison hyperplanes.
hook_first_order_deformation_control.scope: A proved obstruction for this sparse first-order family, not an unrestricted advance or established novelty claim.

sparse_growing_corner_deformation_contro.uniform_conclusion: Every flat first-order deformation of the sparse plane ideal (y^r,y^k*z,y^(k-1)*z^2,...,y*z^k,z^s), k>=2 and r,s>=2k+1, has O(n^2) initial ideals at quotient length n=2*(r+s-1+k*(k-1)/2). Three residue blocks have total interface dimension at most twelve and a linear number of internal comparison hyperplanes.
sparse_growing_corner_deformation_contro.scope: A uniform growing-corner obstruction, not an unrestricted advance or established novelty claim. These fixtures check exact selected weights and do not enumerate the full fan.

thick_hook_deformation_control.uniform_conclusion: For all compatible thick-hook first-order tails, q<=12*a*b and at most 120*m internal hyperplanes give O(n^2*(a*b)^4) initial ideals by optional-column refinement. Together with the prior annihilator bound this is O(min(n^(7/3),n^2*(a*b)^4)). Fixed thickness is therefore insufficient for a stronger unrestricted lower bound.
thick_hook_deformation_control.scope: A parameter-sensitive restricted upper bound, not an unrestricted advance or novelty claim. These are selected-weight controls, not fan enumeration.

power_substitution_negative_control.scope: Exact selected-weight controls support the uniform free-extension proof; this does not enumerate either full fan.

koszul_support_matching_negative_control.uniform_constraint: For any coefficients, the shifted columns of two polynomials satisfy G*F-F*G=0 whenever these products fit without truncation. The displayed integer specialization has rank exactly five.
koszul_support_matching_negative_control.scope: A classical Koszul relation used as a realizability control, not a novel syzygy theorem or an asymptotic lower bound.

untruncated_convolution_rank_and_basis_c.uniform_conclusion: For coprime nonzero F,G and convex lattice-complete multiplier domains, the kernel is (H*G,-H*F) with H in the Newton-polytope erosion domain. Its translated leading terms determine every coherent basis, and the projected basis polytope is a translate of minus the kernel dimension times the tagged Newton polytope. Common factors may be removed before applying the formula. No quotient truncation is allowed.
untruncated_convolution_rank_and_basis_c.priority: An elementary consequence of the classical two-generator syzygy and Newton-product identity; novelty is not established.

factorial_boundary_control.uniform_conclusion: For I_L=(x^2,z^L-x*A_L(z)) over characteristic zero or p>L-1, length is 2L and there are exactly L+1 global initial ideals, versus two positive coherent bases in the corresponding untruncated convolution. Two disjoint arms give length 4t+2 and exactly (t+1)^2 initial ideals; their interaction dimension is zero.
factorial_boundary_control.scope: A proved boundary mechanism and sharp restricted quadratic control below the existing generic lower order. Classical Toeplitz/Padé ingredients; novelty and an unrestricted advance are not established.

positive_curve_collision_control.uniform_conclusion: Positive monomial-curve divisors of the same length and exponent tuple have identical monomial residue matroids and identical positive Groebner fans, including all collisions with multiplicity. Collision within this class cannot amplify the fan.
positive_curve_collision_control.priority: A consequence of classical sparse positive-root bounds and confluent generalized Vandermonde theory; no new interpolation theorem is claimed.

checks.scope: Finite checks use all seven-box staircases and all 37 saved coherent bases. Equality for every positive divisor of degree n is proved in the note, not inferred from these four profiles.

monogenic_embedding_control.uniform_conclusion: Over characteristic zero, a finite algebra admits an embedding with the labeled generic corner-cut fan if and only if it is monogenic. For every monogenic algebra a nonempty Zariski open set of coordinate tuples has this fan. The fixed abstract curvilinear algebra K[u]/(u^n) has both one-initial-ideal and C_d(n)-initial-ideal embeddings.
monogenic_embedding_control.scope: Generic embeddings are not asserted to maximize the fan count; the existing seven-point countercontrol rules that out. This does not improve G_d or F_d and does not complete the goal.

checks.field_scope: Uniform statements are over characteristic zero; the characteristic-two failure is deliberate.
checks.scope: Classical Vandermonde and open-minor consequences, not a new unrestricted counting theorem or an established novelty claim.

sparse_prefix_interpolation_control.scope: Two-generator module columns inside the actual monomial quotient K[y,z]/(y^R,y^k*z^k,z^R). The full monomial configuration of a three-variable ideal has extra powers of the tag variable and is not counted here.
sparse_prefix_interpolation_control.conclusion: Perfect support matching does not imply normal geometric-prefix rank. This subcheck certifies a nonzero null vector for every fixture and exact rank at k=2. The subsequent graded-Jordan argument determines the uniform exact defect k^2/4.

jordan_filtered_convolution_control.uniform_rank_formula: For distinct scalar nodes tau_i and total-degree cuts a_i, rank of sum_i exp(tau_i*L)*B_{<a_i} is sum_strings min(length,sum_i clamp(a_i-start,0,length)).
jordan_filtered_convolution_control.sparse_family_exact_defect: For every even k>=2 the selected 4k^2-column prefix has rank 4k^2-k^2/4. This follows from the known two-variable strong Lefschetz theorem and the rank formula.
jordan_filtered_convolution_control.scope: This controls total-degree filtrations and the full exponential-graph algebra on diagonal weights. It does not count its full positive Groebner fan or improve the unrestricted asymptotic bounds.

unequal_weight_jordan_countercontrol.conclusion: Even the same graded algebra and the same L and tag element have different full fans under different degree-one generating coordinates. Graded Jordan data determine the proved diagonal support function but not unequal-weight costs or the full fan count.
unequal_weight_jordan_countercontrol.scope: Exact falsification certificates for a transfer lemma, not an asymptotic lower bound or a novelty claim.
